SCHEDULE I

FEMALE ATHLETIC COACHES

The annual salary of the following shall be increased above the salary guide based on the first step in Schedule A of the current salary guide as follows:

Basketball .................................. 4%
Volleyball ................................... 4%
Bowling ...................................... 6.5%
Swimming ..................................... 4%

Longevity
   5 years ................................. $100.
  10 years ................................. $100.
  20 years ................................. 100.

The following amounts will be paid in addition to normal stipends:

Cheerleaders ............................. $100. per person
Varsity and Junior Varsity ............... $100. per person
Twirlers .................................. $ 50. per person
Pep Squad ................................. $ 50. per person
Color Guard ............................... $ 50. per person
Strutters ................................. $ 50. per person
